talulah.name: Talulah
talulah.trait: Blocks 2 enemies and can deal <@ba.kw>Elemental damage</>.
talents: Attacks deal Arts damage and inflict Burn damage equal to {ep_damage_ratio:0%} of Arts damage dealt. After {arcane_idle_delay}s without attacking, Arts and Elemental damage gradually increase, up to {arcane_max:0%}; each attack removes one increment.

While deployed, enemies leave burning footprints on traversable ground for 5s after a Burn burst. Up to {max_count} tiles; each lasts {field_duration}s and deals {field_atk_scale:0%} ATK as Arts damage every {field_interval:0.0}s.
skills: Deal <@ba.vup>{atk_scale:0%}</> ATK as Arts damage to all ground enemies on the target tile and inflict Fear for {fear:0.0}s.

Gain <@ba.vup>{damage_resistance:0%}</> Shelter, maintained for {shelter_hold_duration:0.0}s before decaying. Retaliate with {retaliate_atk_scale:0%} ATK as area Arts damage and heal for {heal_ratio:0%} of damage dealt. For {stack_duration}s, attack all blocked enemies and gain <@ba.vup>+{atk:0%}</> ATK and DEF, stacking up to {max_stack_cnt} times.
<@ba.rem>Triggered by incoming attacks; stores {max_stack_cnt} charges.</>

ATK <@ba.vup>+{atk:0%}</>. Stop attacking and summon fire waves in 5 lanes along the deployed direction every {normal_interval:0.00}s. Collisions explode for {heatwave_atk_scale:0%} ATK as Arts damage, or Elemental damage against enemies in a Burn burst.
Overdrive: interval becomes {overload_interval}s and coverage expands to up to 13 lanes. Repeated hits from the same wave deal {same_wave_repeat_damage_scale:0%} damage.

territoriya.name: Территория
territoriya.trait: Attacks <@ba.kw>all enemies</> in range. Has 50% Physical and Arts Dodge and is less likely to be targeted.
territoriya.moduleAdditional: Movement Speed of enemies within attack range <@ba.vdown>-20%</>.
talents: Territory covers attack range. Ground enemies on Territory have {attack_speed} ASPD and take {atk_scale:0%} ATK as Arts damage every second.
When retreating, deal {atk_scale:0%} ATK as Arts damage and Stun all ground enemies on Territory for {stun}s, then remove all Territory.
skills: ASPD <@ba.vup>+{attack_speed}</>. Slow each enemy for {sluggish}s when it first enters Territory.

Expand attack range, ATK <@ba.vup>+{atk:0%}</>. Enemies on Territory cannot dodge Physical or Arts attacks.
<@ba.rem>From the second use onward, also gain +{attack_speed} ASPD and unlimited duration.</>

Expand attack range, ATK <@ba.vup>+{atk:0%}</>, ASPD <@ba.vup>+{attack_speed}</>. Attack all ground enemies on Territory. When a ground enemy attacks a unit on Territory, expand Territory to the four adjacent tiles around the attacker and deal {attack@aoe_atk_scale:0%} ATK as Physical damage (at most once every {attack@cd}s).
<@ba.rem>Reset Territory when the skill ends.</>

toska.name: Тоска
talents: When one of her Trigger Effects activates, recover {sp} SP and heal an allied Operator in range for {heal_scale:0%} ATK.
After applying a Trigger Effect, the next normal attack deals area damage, inflicts 20% Weaken for {attack@t2_buff_duration}s and deals {attack@t2_magic_atk_scale:0%} ATK as Arts damage each second.
skills: Apply a Trigger Effect to {max_target} allied Operators in range who do not have it: when attacked, gain a Barrier equal to {shield_atk_scale:0%} of Toska's ATK, decaying over {shield_time}s, and Stun the attacker for {stun}s.

Apply a Trigger Effect to {max_target} allied Operator anywhere on the field who does not have it: when their skill is ready, gain <@ba.vup>+{attack_speed}</> ASPD for {buff_duration}s and automatically activate skills during this period.

ASPD <@ba.vup>+{attack_speed}</>. Attacks deal {attack@atk_scale:0%} ATK as Physical damage to {attack@max_target} enemies and Stun for {attack@stun}s. Apply a Trigger Effect to another ally in range, or trigger the existing one immediately.
When the holder activates a skill, the holder and Toska gain <@ba.vup>+{bonus_init_atk:0%}</> ATK, decaying over {bonus_duration}s. Transfer the effect to another Operator in Toska's range with the highest SP ratio. While Toska's skill is active, the holder gains {bonus_sp} SP per second.
